description: Set the actual checkbox/radio checked state with a native pointer action only when needed. Unchecking a radio fails; the resulting checked state is read back. Optional target_id addresses only that already-owned page without selecting, creating or focusing it. Requires the declared native browser transport. On the typed native click path, load_waits distinguishes a completed input dispatch from page/frame load observation: a 250ms classification deadline or bounded completion deadline does not assert that the page loaded; no click is replayed.

timeout_ms.description: Effective locator maximum is 3000ms; sequential typing maximum is 5000ms. Typed clicks separately observe load start for 250ms and completion for at most 3000ms; load_waits reports the actual outcome. Other typed actions do not add a navigation-settling wait.

target_id.description: Exact already-owned page returned by browser.tabs or browser.tab_new. This does not select, show, create, or focus that page.
